Skipping a stop? Pick any From → To below and it computes the DIRECT distance & time between those two exact points (straight-line × Tokyo street factor — not a sum of the in-between legs). Works fully offline; the red button opens the exact live walking route when you're online. Estimates ±20%.
DAY1

KUL → Hanoi → night train to Sapa

Thu 4 Dec · Lands 08:25 · full day in Hanoi · sleeper out tonight · no hotel today
22° / 15°
cloudy
06:10
✈ KUL → HAN · lands Nội Bài 08:25
09:30
Airport → town, about 45 min. You’re on a sleeper tonight, so there’s no room to drop bags — sort storage first.
—
SORT FIRSTLuggage storageno hotel to check into📍Old Quarter cafes and tour offices store bags by the piece, about 50,000đ. If the sleeper is booked through an agency, ask them first — it’s often free.
—
TO FILLThe Hanoi day: what you want to see between ~10:00 and the sleeper. Hoàn Kiếm, Old Quarter, Train Street, the Temple of Literature, egg coffee — tell me which and I’ll sequence it with walking times.
夜
TO FILLSleeper to Sapa — bus or train? They’re very different: the train goes to Lào Cai and needs a 1h minibus on top, the bus goes door to door in ~6h. Departure time and operator when you have them.

Sapa

Fri 5 Dec · Full day in the mountains
15° / 8°
cold · morning fog
—
TO FILLSapa plans — trekking, Fansipan cable car, the villages (Cát Cát, Tả Van), or a homestay? Sapa in December is 8–15°C and often in cloud, which changes what’s worth doing.

Sat 6 Dec · Last day up there · sleeper back tonight

—
STOCK UPThings you’ll want on the sleeperbuy before you board📍There are small supermarkets in Sapa town. Water, snacks, wet wipes, earplugs, an eye mask — none of it is available on board, and the carriage gets cold.
DAY4

Hanoi

Sun 7 Dec · Back in the city · Sunday walking streets
22° / 15°
cloudy
早
The sleeper gets in early. Hotels usually won’t check you in before 14:00 — leave the bags and go and eat.
全天
SUNDAY ONLYHoàn Kiếm weekend walking streetsFri evening → Sun night · closed to traffic📍The lake and part of the Old Quarter close to traffic: street performers, stalls, kids’ games. Your day falls on the Sunday — worth building the evening around.
—
TO FILLThe rest of Sunday, plus the hotel once it’s booked.

Flight 14:50 → 19:15. Allow 3 hours for an international departure and 45 min to the airport, so leave around 11:00. That still leaves roughly three usable morning hours.

🧳Pack & Prepare — my own checklist

Yours to edit: tick things off, rename them, set quantities, jot remarks, add or delete items and whole groups. Saved on this phone only. Coloured chips are reminders pulled from the trip's airport rules — red ones are worth obeying.

🛍Shopping list — what I’m hunting fori

Everyone’s list is different, so there’s one sample here to show the shape of it. Every field is editable and you can add your own. Put -1 in Quantity and it shows as “as many as possible”. Price is free text — write it the way you saw it on the shelf. Saved on this phone only.

How the shopping list works
✅
Tick as you buy. The bar at the top counts down.
✎
Edit opens the details — where to buy, links, quantity, price, photo, remark. Kept closed so the list stays short.
∞
Quantity −1 means “as many as possible”.
📱
Saved on this device only. Use sync to move it to your phone.
STEP BY STEP
  1. Add an item — press ＋ New item at the top (a blank card opens right there), or type a name in the box at the bottom and press Add.
  2. Copy duplicates a card right under the original — handy for the same snack in a different flavour or shop.
  3. 🚫 Skipping (To-try list only) — the dropdown beside the To-try button. Tick anyone not having it; it saves at once and shows as Skipping: name, name on the card. The Top Skip Person table at the bottom ranks who skips the most.
  4. Fill in what you know. Every field is optional. Where to buy and Reference links take several values separated by commas, and become tappable chips.
  5. Paste a photo URL to see it beside the item. If it shows “Photo didn’t load”, the link has expired — replace it.
  6. Tick it once bought. The card fades and the counter moves.
  7. To delete, open Edit and use the red button at the very bottom — placed away from everything else on purpose.
  8. Moving to your phone? Open { } sync / backup below, press Copy, then paste it into the same panel on the phone and press Load.
One caution: the list lives in this browser. Clearing browsing data wipes it, and it does not sync by itself — that is what the sync panel is for.
{ } Sync & backup
Just the souvenir list. Copy here, paste into this same tab on the other device — your To-try list is left untouched.
Just the To-try list. Same idea — loading here replaces only this list, not your souvenirs.
Everything at once — both shopping lists, packing list, expense split, reels and your language choice. For moving to a new phone.
⚠ This includes your packing ticks. Pasting an older backup will roll those back too.
Loading checks the text first, tells you what it found, and asks before replacing anything. A section you have never touched has nothing saved yet, so it will not appear in the copy — that is normal.
